Job Description AI Engineer




Experience: 14 Years


Location: Lower Ground Floor, Spencer Plaza Mall, Unit No: B2, No. 769, Phase-1, Anna Salai, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600002


Department: Technology / AI & Machine Learning




Job Summary




We are looking for an AI Engineer with 14 years of experience in developing, implementing, and deploying AI/ML solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong Python programming skills and hands-on experience with machine learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs).

Key Responsibilities

Develop and implement AI/ML models and applications.
Build AI-powered solutions using Python and relevant frameworks.
Work with Generative AI, LLMs, and prompt engineering.
Develop and integrate APIs for AI-based applications.
Perform data preprocessing, model evaluation, and optimization.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver AI solutions.
Deploy and maintain AI models in production environments.

Required Skills

Strong programming knowledge in Python.
Hands-on experience with Machine Learning and Deep Learning.
Knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, and NLP.
Familiarity with frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or RAG is an advantage.
Knowledge of REST APIs, SQL, Git, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.

Preferred Candidates

Candidates with hands-on project experience in AI applications, chatbot development, LLM integration, or AI model deployment will be preferred.




Interested Candidate Reach out to - 9790850988 Monica HR /Monica@creditmantri.com
